meta.title: Global Todos
meta.description: Cross-session todos for DeepSeek Harness whose central rule is that an agent's "done" is not completion. Whether the agent reports it from a tool or the host infers it when a dispatched conversation ends cleanly, the record waits in Needs review: a person confirms it, or it goes back to the list. One JSON file you own, written by both sides, with created time, description, attached documents and links, a plan of steps and the sentence it came from; hand an item to a conversation in one click and read back what that conversation last said.
